meta.name: get-qodo-rules
meta.description: Loads org- and repo-level coding rules from Qodo before code tasks begin, ensuring all generation and modification follows team standards. Use before any code generation or modification task when rules are not already loaded. Invoke when user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or when starting implementation planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加载团队编码规则，确保代码符合规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队有编码规则需要自动遵守
copy.tagline_en: Load team coding rules to ensure code compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has coding rules to enforce automatically

howto.what: Claude 会在代码生成或修改前先确认规则是否已加载;若未加载,从 Qodo 拉取团队编码规则,输出按严重程度分组的清单,并遵照执行;完成后汇报哪些规则已被应用。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写、修改或审查代码等任务,进入实现规划时触发;若对话中已有“Qodo Rules Loaded”则跳过。

say.note: 触发拉取并显示团队编码规则。

say.text: 写代码前先拉取一下团队规则
say.note: Claude 会先获取规则再动手。

say.text: 按 Qodo 规则重构这段代码
say.note: 加载规则并按错误级别执行。

howto.what_en: Before code tasks, Claude checks if rules are already loaded; if not, it fetches coding rules from Qodo, prints them grouped by severity, enforces them, and reports which rules were applied.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to write, edit, or review code, or starts implementation planning, unless rules are already loaded.

say_en.note: Fetches and displays team coding rules.

say_en.text: Pull team rules before writing code
Refactor this code following Qodo rules
